cohort: The study included 8,744 women who gave birth at the Clinic for Obstetrics and Gynecology in Pristina between January and December 2022.
finding: Maternal age >35 years, parity >3, preterm birth, cervical/vaginal/perineal lacerations, and placenta accreta spectrum were identified as significant risk factors for primary postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: No statistically significant association was found between primary postpartum hemorrhage and previous cesarean delivery or mode of delivery.
